description: This PHP class 'EmployeeAddress' models an employee's address, encapsulating properties such as street addresses, city, province, zipcode, and country. It provides functionality to convert the address to a string, including resolving the country's name via a repository. It's part of a reporting/display component within the OrangeHRM human resource management system.

classes.name: EmployeeAddress
classes.description: Represents an employee's address with address components and provides a method to render it as a string.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the EmployeeAddress object with address components such as street1, street2, city, province, zipcode, and country.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts the address to a string, including country name if available, concatenated with commas.
